item.text:
**Bottom line**
Mixed, leaning yes on discipline and coercive control, but not on clean administrative smoothness. In 2024 Trọng’s camp could still compel top-level personnel changes, push formal implementation plans, and issue tighter audit/discipline rules. But the anti-graft drive also produced bureaucracy freeze, leadership churn, and by mid-July direct day-to-day control had shifted away from him.

**Accepted claims**
- **Government of Viet Nam | 2024-01-08 | [Major tasks and solutions to implement 2024 socio-economic development plan](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/major-tasks-and-solutions-to-implement-2024-socio-economic-development-plan-111240108212720274.htm)**  
  Claim: the 2024 plan translated the leadership line into concrete state priorities on macro stability, inflation control, institutional reform, and budget-linked execution, which is evidence of apparatus-wide coordination around a program.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.2`

- **Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-21 | [Vietnam names acting president after legislature votes to remove Thuong](https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-names-acting-president-after-legislature-votes-to-remove-thuong/2009559/)**  
  Claim: removing a top official and installing an acting president through formal constitutional procedure shows the ruling party could police elite misconduct and keep succession moving.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.4`, `8B.2`

- **Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-04-19 | [Vietnam's Communist Party reprimands labour minister amid anti-graft campaign](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AIC-INC-16083583/news/Vietnam-s-Communist-Party-reprimands-labour-minister-amid-anti-graft-campaign-46478047/)**  
  Claim: the Politburo publicly reprimanded a minister for failures under his leadership and Reuters said hundreds of officials and executives had already been prosecuted, which is strong evidence of internal discipline and cadre control.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.4`

- **Government of Viet Nam | 2024-07-08 | [Toàn văn phát biểu của Tổng Bí thư Nguyễn Phú Trọng gửi Hội nghị Quân ủy Trung ương](https://baochinhphu.vn/toan-van-phat-bieu-cua-tong-bi-thu-nguyen-phu-trong-gui-hoi-nghi-quan-uy-trung-uong-102240708183856132.htm)**  
  Claim: Trọng was still issuing concrete direction to the military and defense apparatus in July, so he was still trying to coordinate the security side of the state around his line before the handoff.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.4`

- **Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-05-17 | [Exclusive: Vietnam forfeits billions of dollars in foreign aid amid anti-graft freeze, document says](https://theprint.in/world/exclusive-vietnam-forfeits-billions-of-dollars-in-foreign-aid-amid-anti-graft-freeze-document-says/2088974/)**  
  Claim: the anti-corruption drive caused administrative paralysis, delayed approvals, and lost aid, which is direct counterevidence that the apparatus was being effectively coordinated and driven through smoothly.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.4`

- **Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-05-20 | [Vietnam removes third top leader in two months, reshuffles cadres](https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-removes-third-top-leader-in-two-months-reshuffles-cadres/2092648/)**  
  Claim: Reuters described upheaval, infighting, and a chilling effect on bureaucracy, which weakens any claim of stable follow-through across ministries and party structures.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.4`

- **Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-26 | [Vietnam minister says president's resignation has not affected policies](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/vietnam-hopes-us-will-soon-recognize-its-market-economy-status-fm-son-says-3353681)**  
  Claim: the foreign minister said Vietnam’s policy continuity rested on collective leadership, not one person, which is moderate evidence for institutional continuity but also undercuts a highly personalistic control story.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.2`, `8B.4`

- **Government of Viet Nam | 2024-11-26 | [Viet Nam Social Security News](https://vss.gov.vn/english/news/Pages/vietnam-social-security.aspx?CateID=198&ItemID=12375)**  
  Claim: the VSS plan created a steering group, assigned unit responsibilities, set a nationwide roadmap, and ordered inspection and guidance, which is good evidence of implementation follow-through inside a large bureaucracy.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.2`, `8B.4`

- **State Audit Office of Viet Nam | 2024-11-27 | [Ban hành mới Hệ thống chuẩn mực kiểm toán nhà nước](https://sav.gov.vn/vi/bai-viet/ban-hanh-moi-he-thong-chuan-muc-kiem-toan-nha-nuoc-2024-11-27-14-53-43)**  
  Claim: the SAV issued 43 audit standards and tied them to professional ethics, quality control, and audit competence, which is evidence of institutional discipline and formalization.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.4`

- **Government of Viet Nam | 2024-07-18 | [Politburo issues notice on Party General Secretary's health](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/politburo-issues-notice-on-party-general-secretarys-health-111240718161208612.htm)**  
  Claim: the Politburo transferred Trọng’s duties to Tô Lâm for the immediate future, which is strong evidence that by mid-July effective day-to-day control had moved away from him.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.4`

- **Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-07-19 | [Vietnam's top leader Trong dies at 80, party says](https://theprint.in/world/vietnams-top-leader-trong-dies-at-80-party-says/2181868/)**  
  Claim: Reuters tied his death directly to the July 18 duty transfer, confirming that the second half of 2024 cannot be read as personally managed by Trọng in any strong sense.  
  IDs: `8B.5`, also `8B.4`

**Search gap**
I did not find a single source showing Trọng personally orchestrating cross-ministry execution end-to-end in 2024. The evidence is mostly indirect: party discipline, agency implementation plans, and audit formalization on the yes side, versus bureaucracy freeze, reshuffle churn, and the July handoff on the no side.
